turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Who decided on Owen's zero, and did anyone talk to him first?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero was based on.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Read it yourself.
Let me see it. People draft somewhere else and paste it in, so a paste proves nothing by itself. And was Owen asked about any of this before you entered the zero?
If he drafted somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you.

I've written your times down, Hale. Whatever comes of this, nothing goes on his record and nobody in that class hears about it. And you still haven't told me whether Owen was heard before that zero went in.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. It is not in Hamlet. Search the play yourself.
A seventeen-year-old misremembering a line is a citation error, not a zero. And you've now skipped my question twice.

You mentioned his December 1 deadline. Under 4.4 he can do a supervised rewrite this Thursday, private, in my room. I will mark it by Monday, so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, and nothing goes on his record. I will put the dates in writing tonight.

I never said December 1, but that is his deadline. He'll do the rewrite to put this behind him, private, in your room. Tonight's email gives the dates, says the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record, and that no one in that class hears a word of this.
He'll be in your room Thursday. Send the email.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

You agreed today that Owen will do a private supervised rewrite in your room this Thursday, that you will mark it by Monday, and that the new mark will replace the zero with nothing placed on his record. I still require written confirmation that no one in his class will hear of this, and an answer to the question you did not answer in our meeting: whether Owen was heard before the zero was entered. I expect the dates in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position; she agreed Owen will do a private supervised rewrite Thursday, marked by Monday, replacing the zero with nothing on his record, and she still wants all of that in writing tonight, along with silence in front of his class and an answer on whether he was heard first; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: you showed the version history with exact times and answered her pasting defence by asking for the other file's own dates, which gave her something dated she could check herself.
What cost ground: you never answered whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, even after she raised it twice, so the procedural gap stayed open and went into her email.
What she never said: one night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay's writing between 11:31 and 11:58 PM on October 28, a late October night very close to what she saw, which proves nothing about the essay but is why she pressed so hard on procedure.
Try next time: right after your apology for entering the zero early, say in one sentence whether you spoke with Owen first under 4.1, so she has nothing left to hold over the process.
